final: WITH groups AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, AVG(1.0 * s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_y_to_z, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON CAST(s.arcref AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(p.arcregistry AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.fundflux), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count FROM groups), kept AS (SELECT g.avg_y_to_z, g.record_count, g.record_count - a.mean_count AS count_difference FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN avg_count AS a WHERE a.mean_count IS NOT NULL AND g.record_count > a.mean_count) SELECT AVG(avg_y_to_z) AS average_y_to_z_average, SUM(record_count) AS total_count, AVG(count_difference) AS average_count_difference FROM kept
